name: woodmodels
description: Test tooling for the WoodModels cut-list viewer (the viewer itself has no build step).

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:py && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit.test.mjs tests/wood.test.mjs tests/design.test.mjs tests/modeling.test.mjs tests/joinery_geometry.test.mjs tests/mechanisms.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: node tests/viewer_smoke.mjs && node tests/modeling_smoke.mjs && node tests/design_polish_smoke.mjs && node tests/joinery_smoke.mjs && node tests/mechanisms_smoke.mjs
